gold.title: The downsize method is defined twice. The second definition, which expects a single dimensions string parameter, overrid
gold.description: The downsize method is defined twice. The second definition, which expects a single dimensions string parameter, overrides the first, which expected separate max_width and max_height parameters. This makes the original method unreachable and breaks existing code that calls it with separate width and height arguments.

candidate.title: Duplicate `self.downsize` definition silently shadows the 4-arg version, breaking `Jobs::ResizeEmoji`
candidate.description: Method at line 149 redefines line 145, shadowing it. Ruby keeps only the last definition (arity 3..4). Caller at app/jobs/regular/resize_emoji.rb:14 passes 5 args → ArgumentError.

gold.title: Hardcoding maxSizeKB = 10 * 1024 ignores Discourse.SiteSettings['max_' + type + '_size_kb'], so the client-side limit ca
gold.description: Hardcoding maxSizeKB = 10 * 1024 ignores Discourse.SiteSettings['max_' + type + '_size_kb'], so the client-side limit can diverge from server-side and per-type settings (also applies to the 413 handler below).

candidate.title: Client-side size check hardcoded to 10MB now governs attachments, not just images
candidate.description: Hardcoded 10MB replaces dynamic setting lookup, removing max_attachment_size_kb from client validation. Legitimate attachments blocked on sites with higher limits; server error differs from client message.

gold.title: Passing 80% as the dimensions can fail for animated GIFs when allow_animated_thumbnails is true, since the animated path
gold.description: Passing 80% as the dimensions can fail for animated GIFs when allow_animated_thumbnails is true, since the animated path uses gifsicle --resize-fit which expects WxH geometry, not a percentage; downsizing would then silently fail.

candidate.title: `"80%"` is not a valid geometry for the animated-GIF branch, so large animated GIFs fail all 5 attempts
candidate.description: gifsicle --resize-fit rejects percentage geometry (accepts only WxH). Fails 5 times, then Upload.create_for rejects oversized file. Non-animated path silently strips animation.

promotion_candidates.title: SVG uploads are pushed through ImageMagick, contrary to the SVG carve-out every other call site has
promotion_candidates.description: SVGs over size limit are rasterized by convert, mangling the vector while filename remains .svg. OptimizedImage.create_for and Upload.create_for handle SVGs with Nokogiri instead.
